semanticReview.method: Author-led review of the profession boundary, weekly prerequisite chain, every fact pair, distractor family, Build dependency, proof demand, and official reference. Deterministic validators only verify the serialized evidence; they do not create this approval.
findingsReviewed: Every week teaches before assessing and builds immediately after assessment.
Ten questions assess explanation and application selection while coding remains in Build.
The sequence grows from syntax to structured independent work without frameworks or hidden algebra.
Every course ends with GitHub publication; setup remains outside the 48 instructional hours.
semanticReview.adversarialResult: No untaught assessment dependency or hidden Build prerequisite remains.
